topics.name: AccessCore Group Rights
topics.purpose: Define AccessCore groups and explicit rights inheritance/composition so `system-group` and other groups can grant scoped rights without implicit transitive expansion.

semantics.rights_rule: Group carries explicit resource/operation rights such as read/write/invoke.
semantics.system_group_rule: `system-group` may have its declared rights (for example rw where configured) through explicit policy rather than hard-coded universal bypass.
semantics.inheritance_rule: Group-to-group inheritance, if supported, is explicit and cycle-validated.
semantics.union_rule: Multiple group memberships compose rights according to explicit policy.
semantics.deny_rule: Explicit deny/precedence semantics are declared rather than guessed.
semantics.authority_rule: Group membership never changes IdentityCore identity or IAM assurance.

invariants.rule: AccessCore decisions are explicit policy evaluations over identity, resource and operation context; authentication assurance, visibility and ownership never silently become authorization.

hard_gates.condition: group membership inferred from role/name text
multiple groups resolved by file order
